purpose: Institutionalize parallel raw-number-hit accumulation while continuing evidence promotion separately, ingest newly surfaced spectroscopy/materials/sensing publications into Worldshepherd, and run a first density-only sanity check on the Sr I 60057/60705 P2 motif over the full 208-state three-family union.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, repeated database records, alternate landing pages, and derivative copies are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Raw exact-number occurrence is retained for collision statistics, but DOI suffixes, article numbers, page numbers, registry identifiers, serials, software IDs and no-hit results are not Glob evidence unless independently promoted through the physical-evidence gates.

raw_reservoir.scope: Exact/near-exact raw hits, duplicate source classes, and explicit no-hit observations are retained separately from promoted evidence.

uniform_density_approximation.interpretation: The raw two-hit count is consistent with the line density of this very dense spectrum under a simple uniform approximation.

sr_i_complete_table_sanity.same_orbit_note: 60057 and 60705 remain in the same 13524 orbit 67500->65070->60057->60705 and the same documented Sr I absorption system. The relational motif remains P2 by the working definition, but this density sanity check does not establish statistical anomaly.
sr_i_complete_table_sanity.claims_boundary: Feature rows are treated as an approximate density denominator and are not independent identically distributed lines. This is not a formal p-value and does not replace topology-preserving matched controls.

information_updates.finding: Worldshepherd now preserves raw-number-hit accumulation as a first-class reservoir separate from evidence promotion. Weak hits are retained for collision statistics instead of discarded or silently promoted.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Raw hit frequency may inform null models but has zero automatic causal or physical significance.

information_updates.finding: Only 60057 and 60705 among the 34 three-family states inside the published Sr I table span fall within the fixed 1 cm^-1 target tolerance. A simple uniform feature-density model expects about 1.86 hits, so the count of two alone is not anomalous.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The within-orbit/common-system relationship remains the more informative structure; topology-preserving nulls are still required.

next_actions: Continue raw exact-number hit accumulation across all 208 union states and append source-class counts without pruning weak hits.
Add retrieval query, date, source-domain class, occurrence type and duplicate-group IDs to future raw-reservoir records so collision-rate estimates can be stratified.
Run topology-preserving matched controls for the Sr I same-orbit motif rather than interpreting the two-hit count alone.
Preserve the fixed 1 cm^-1 tolerance and apply experiment-wide multiple-testing and false-discovery correction across all 208 states before interpreting aggregate physical-hit counts.
Continue authoritative same-species scans for W II, Mo III, Pb III, N I, Mn XVIII, NS and additional physical systems while raw accumulation runs independently.
